      "url": "https://www.getaleph.com",

      "featureList": [
        "Data Consolidation - Connect and transform source data using no-code tools",

        "Security & Compliance - Keep your data secure and compliance team happy",
        "Aleph Intelligence (AI) - End-to-end intelligence for FP&A",
        "Financial Reporting & Close - Generate routine financial statements in seconds",
        "Modeling & Forecasting - Harness the power of a platform and flexibility of spreadsheets",
        "Collaborative Budgeting - Build a better budgeting process from planning to tracking",
        "Headcount Planning - Automate the busywork with centralized data and assumptions"

      "aggregateRating": {
        "@type": "AggregateRating",
        "ratingValue": 5,
        "reviewCount": 14,
        "bestRating": 5,

      },
      "review": [
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Chris Brubaker",
            "jobTitle": "VP of Finance"
          },
          "reviewBody": "Implementing Aleph was insanely fast. We did all of our quarter-end reporting with Aleph less than 3 weeks after signing.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Brandon Sullivan",
            "jobTitle": "CFO"
          },
          "reviewBody": "I've been born and bred in FP&A for almost 20 years, and kudos to Aleph who built the tool I've always wanted.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Bryce Heinz",
            "jobTitle": "CFO"
          },
          "reviewBody": "The Aleph team has gone above and beyond—clearing the bar by a mile. They've shown up for us at all hours and treated us the way we'd want to treat ourselves. It's been a truly great partnership.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Miranda Conley",
            "jobTitle": "Senior Director of Accounting",
            "worksFor": {
              "@type": "Organization",
              "name": "Zapier"
            }
          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph's flexibility lets us slice and dice data across multiple dimensions faster than our source systems. It's a game changer for how we collaborate and make decisions. If I were ever to leave Zapier, I'd have to take Aleph with me.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Ryan Freudenburg",
            "jobTitle": "Director of FP&A",
            "worksFor": {
              "@type": "Organization",
              "name": "AllCloud"
            }
          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph has totally revolutionized the way that we do FP&A at AllCloud.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Connie Ho",
            "jobTitle": "Sr. Finance Manager"
          },
          "reviewBody": "You weren't kidding when you said it's plug-and-play and you immediately play. We were up and running in the same week.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Jon Gross",
            "jobTitle": "CFO"
          },
          "reviewBody": "I would say on the spectrum of FP&A tools out there, Aleph is the most user-friendly one that I've come across.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Axel Amar",
            "jobTitle": "Sr. Director of FP&A"
          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph added the output of at least one analyst without hiring anyone, and by the end of this year, it will be two.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Omar Asghar",
            "jobTitle": "Director of FP&A"
          },
          "reviewBody": "The first two years, finance was seen as a gatekeeper. Now, with Aleph, we're viewed as trusted partners who bring insights in real time. That's priceless.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Gregory Silva",
            "jobTitle": "Head of Finance"
          },
          "reviewBody": "There are tons of instances where Aleph saves us two hours here, three hours there, eight hours here.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Joe Dizon",
            "jobTitle": "Director of Finance"
          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph has made the deliverables process a lot smoother while giving us more confidence in the numbers.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Ani Kochiashvili",
            "jobTitle": "Finance Technology Lead",
            "worksFor": {
              "@type": "Organization",
              "name": "Y Combinator"
            }
          },
          "reviewBody": "YC is hesitant to build processes around a solution as new as Aleph, but Aleph was worth the risk.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Review",
          "author": {
            "@type": "Person",
            "name": "Yazmi Miah",
            "jobTitle": "Strategic Finance & Business Operations"
          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph has significantly accelerated our workflows—tasks that once took days now only require a few hours.",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        },

          "@type": "Review",

            "@type": "Person",

          },
          "reviewBody": "Aleph allowed us to update our financial reporting with just a few clicks, in Excel",
          "reviewRating": {
            "@type": "Rating",
            "ratingValue": 5
          }
        }

<!-- 2026-09-22 B-motion (audit G M6 / D3a): reduced-motion early return + stop on change; fixed 30 px/s;
     pause on hover AND focus-within; below 768px render static (logos: first 8 items; testimonials: stop + de-clone only), no clones, no rAF. -->
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const marquees = document.querySelectorAll('[cl-marquee="list"]');
    if (!marquees.length) return;

    const rm = window.matchMedia ? matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : null;
    const SPEED_PX_PER_S = 30;      // WDS ambient ticker speed (was contentWidth / cl-marquee-speed ≈ 40 px/s)
    const STATIC_BELOW = 768;       // no marquee on small screens
    const STATIC_ITEM_CAP = 8;      // items shown when static

    function renderStatic(marquee, content, capItems) {
      Array.from(marquee.children).forEach(child => {
        if (child !== content) marquee.removeChild(child);
      });
      marquee.style.transform = '';
      if (!capItems) return;   // testimonials: agent C's snap scroller owns the layout below 768
      Array.from(content.children).forEach((item, i) => {
        item.style.display = i < STATIC_ITEM_CAP ? '' : 'none';
      });
    }

    function initializeMarquee(marquee) {
      const wrapper = marquee.closest('[cl-marquee="wrapper"]');
      const content = marquee.querySelector('[cl-marquee="content"]');
      if (!wrapper || !content) return;

      // Testimonials block (agent C's snap scroller below 768): leave the list untouched — no
      // transforms, no clones, no listeners.
      const isTestimonials = !!(marquee.closest('.customer-testimonials_cl-wrapper') || marquee.closest('.section_customer-testimonials') || marquee.classList.contains('customer-testimonials_cl-list'));
      if (isTestimonials && window.innerWidth < STATIC_BELOW) return;

      marquee.style.transition = 'none';

      const direction = marquee.getAttribute('cl-marquee-direction') === 'reverse' ? 1 : -1;

      // Pause state: speedFactor eases toward targetFactor each frame (1 = running, 0 = stopped).
      let speedFactor = 1;
      let targetFactor = 1;
      const EASE_STRENGTH = 3;

      let offset = 0;
      let lastTime;
      let animationFrameId;
      let staticMode = false;

      function stop() {
        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        animationFrameId = null;
      }

      // Pause on hover and on keyboard focus inside the ticker (always on; the old
      // cl-marquee-pause="hover" opt-in is honoured implicitly).
      wrapper.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { targetFactor = 0; });
      wrapper.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { if (!wrapper.matches(':focus-within')) targetFactor = 1; });
      wrapper.addEventListener('focusin', () => { targetFactor = 0; });
      wrapper.addEventListener('focusout', () => { if (!wrapper.matches(':focus-within')) targetFactor = 1; });

      function shouldBeStatic() {
        return (rm && rm.matches) || window.innerWidth < STATIC_BELOW;
      }

      function setupAndAnimate() {
        stop();

        if (shouldBeStatic()) {
          staticMode = true;
          renderStatic(marquee, content, !isTestimonials);
          return;
        }
        if (staticMode) {
          staticMode = false;
          if (!isTestimonials) Array.from(content.children).forEach(item => { item.style.display = ''; });
        }

        const wrapperWidth = wrapper.offsetWidth;
        const contentWidth = content.offsetWidth;

        if (contentWidth === 0) {
          animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(setupAndAnimate);
          return;
        }

        Array.from(marquee.children).forEach(child => {
          if (child !== content) marquee.removeChild(child);
        });

        const clonesNeeded = Math.ceil(wrapperWidth / contentWidth) + 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < clonesNeeded; i++) {
          const clone = content.cloneNode(true);
          clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          marquee.appendChild(clone);
        }

        lastTime = performance.now();
        offset = direction === 1 ? -contentWidth : 0;

        function animate(now) {
          if (!lastTime) lastTime = now;
          const delta = now - lastTime;
          lastTime = now;

          const t = 1 - Math.exp(-EASE_STRENGTH * (delta / 1000));
          speedFactor += (targetFactor - speedFactor) * t;

          offset += (SPEED_PX_PER_S * delta / 1000) * direction * speedFactor;

          if (direction === -1 && offset <= -contentWidth) {
            offset += contentWidth;
          } else if (direction === 1 && offset >= 0) {
            offset -= contentWidth;
          }

          marquee.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`;
          animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        animate(performance.now());
      }

      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        setTimeout(setupAndAnimate, 100);
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(wrapper);

      if (rm && rm.addEventListener) rm.addEventListener('change', setupAndAnimate);

      setupAndAnimate();
    }

    marquees.forEach(initializeMarquee);
  });

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const MOBILE_LANDSCAPE_MAX = 767;
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.logo-garden_cms-item'));
    if (!items.length) return;

    // Close all cards and reset inline styles
    function closeAllCards() {
      items.forEach(item => {
        const card = item.querySelector('.logo-garden_card-wrap');
        if (card) {
          card.classList.remove('active');
          card.style.transform = '';
          card.style.width = '';
        }
      });
    }

    // Click outside any logo item → close all
    function onDocumentClick(e) {
      if (!e.target.closest('.logo-garden_cms-item')) {
        closeAllCards();
      }
    }

    // Fix horizontal overflow: adjust width + horizontal offset
    function adjustCardHorizontal(card) {
      if (!card) return;

      const padding = 16; // px from viewport edges

      // Reset before measuring
      card.style.transform = '';
      card.style.width = '';

      let rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;

      // 1) If card is wider than available viewport, shrink width
      const maxAllowedWidth = viewportWidth - padding * 2;
      if (rect.width > maxAllowedWidth) {
        card.style.width = maxAllowedWidth + 'px';
        rect = card.getBoundingClientRect(); // re-measure
      }

      // 2) If card sticks out left/right, shift it with translateX
      let shiftX = 0;

      if (rect.left < padding) {
        shiftX = padding - rect.left;
      } else if (rect.right > viewportWidth - padding) {
        shiftX = -(rect.right - (viewportWidth - padding));
      }

      if (shiftX !== 0) {
        card.style.transform = `translateX(${shiftX}px)`;
      }
    }

    // Fix vertical visibility: scroll page so card is fully visible
    function ensureCardInViewVertical(card) {
      if (!card) return;

      const paddingTop = 120;   // tweak if you have sticky header/banner
      const paddingBottom = 16;

      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;

      let scrollDelta = 0;

      // If top is above safe area → scroll up
      if (rect.top < paddingTop) {
        scrollDelta = rect.top - paddingTop;
      }
      // Else if bottom is below safe area → scroll down
      else if (rect.bottom > viewportHeight - paddingBottom) {
        scrollDelta = rect.bottom - (viewportHeight - paddingBottom);
      }

      if (scrollDelta !== 0) {
        window.scrollBy({
          top: scrollDelta,
          behavior: 'smooth'
        });
      }
    }

    /* ==========================
       MOBILE LANDSCAPE & BELOW
       ========================== */
    if (window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_LANDSCAPE_MAX) {
      items.forEach(item => {
        const logo   = item.querySelector('.logo-garden_logo');
        const card   = item.querySelector('.logo-garden_card-wrap');
        const buttons = item.querySelectorAll('.logo-garden_button-wrap');

        if (!logo || !card) return;

        // Initial state
        card.classList.remove('active');
        card.style.transform = '';
        card.style.width = '';
        logo.style.cursor = 'pointer';

        function isButtonVisible() {
          if (!buttons.length) return false;
          return Array.from(buttons).some(button => {
            const styles = window.getComputedStyle(button);
            return (
              styles.display !== 'none' &&
              styles.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
              styles.opacity !== '0'
            );
          });
        }

        // LOGO CLICK → toggle card (only if button visible)
        logo.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          if (!isButtonVisible()) return;

          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();

          const isActive = card.classList.contains('active');
          closeAllCards();

          if (!isActive) {
            card.classList.add('active');

            // After layout updates, fix horizontal + vertical visibility
            setTimeout(() => {
              adjustCardHorizontal(card);
              ensureCardInViewVertical(card);
            }, 20);
          }
        });

        // BUTTON CLICK → normal navigation, no toggle
        buttons.forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation(); // don't close via document click
          });
        });

        // Clicks inside the card shouldn't close it
        card.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      });

      // Global outside-click listener
      document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClick);
    }

    /* ==========================
       TABLET & ABOVE
       ========================== */
    if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
      initLogoGardenDesktop();
    }
  });
</script></div></div></div></div></div><div class="padding-global"><div class="container-large"><div class="padding-top padding-section-medium"><div class="hero-5_tabs_wrap"><div data-current="Aleph Demo Preview" data-easing="ease" data-duration-in="300" data-duration-out="100" class="headline_tabs_wrap w-tabs"><div class="headline_tabs_menu hide----todo----bug w-tab-menu"><a data-w-tab="Aleph Demo Preview" class="headline_tabs_link w-inline-block w-tab-link w--current"><div class="icon-1x1-xxsmall"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100%" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M12.1716 3H8C6.34315 3 5 4.34315 5 6V18C5 19.6569 6.34315 21 8 21H16C17.6569 21 19 19.6569 19 18V9.82843C19 9.29799 18.7893 8.78929 18.4142 8.41421L13.5858 3.58579C13.2107 3.21071 12.702 3 12.1716 3Z M13 3.5V7C13 8.10457 13.8954 9 15 9H18.5 M8.5 17.5V16 M12 17.5V13 M15.5 17.5V15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" fill="none"></path></svg></div><div class="headline_tabs_text">Financial Reporting</div></a></div><div class="headline_tabs_content w-tab-content"><div data-w-tab="Aleph Demo Preview" class="headline_tabs_panel w-tab-pane w--tab-active"><div class="ai_pill_link cover-absolute is-transparent w-embed w-script"><!-- HOME HERO · reference hero markup (/agentic-budgeting): .hero__video-plate > .hero__video-pad > .hero__video-still > muted loop + button.hero__play. <script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const accordionWrap = document.querySelector('[data-accordion-wrap]');
    if (!accordionWrap) return;

    const accordionElements = accordionWrap.querySelectorAll('.accordion_element_wrap');
    if (accordionElements.length === 0) return;

    const rm = window.matchMedia ? matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : { matches: false };
    const STEP_MS = 4000;

    let currentIndex = 0;
    let interval = null;
    let hasStarted = false;
    let steps = 0;            // steps taken in the current loop
    let completed = false;    // one full loop done, or the user took over
    let userPaused = false;   // pause button
    let hovered = false;
    let focused = false;

    // --- pause / play control (24x24) in the accordion header row ---
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'accordion_pause';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    btn.innerHTML = '<svg class="ap-pause" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.5 3v10M10.5 3v10"/></svg>'
                  + '<svg class="ap-play" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 3.2v9.6a.6.6 0 0 0 .9.5l7.4-4.8a.6.6 0 0 0 0-1L5.4 2.7a.6.6 0 0 0-.9.5z"/></svg>';
    accordionWrap.insertBefore(btn, accordionWrap.firstChild);

    const updateButton = () => {
        const running = !!interval;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', running ? 'false' : 'true');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', running ? 'Pause' : 'Play');
        btn.classList.toggle('is-done', completed && !running);
    };

    const activateElement = (index) => {
        const el = accordionElements[index];
        const trigger = el.querySelector('.accordion_element_trigger');
        accordionElements.forEach((other, i) => {
            const input = other.querySelector('.accordion_element_trigger');
            if (input && i !== index) input.checked = false;
            other.classList.toggle('is-open', i === index);
            other.classList.remove('is-held');
        });
        if (trigger && !trigger.checked) {
            trigger.checked = true;
            trigger.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
        // content reveal: opacity + 4px rise, 180ms (the class carries the transition)
        const content = el.querySelector('.accordion_element_content');
        if (content && !rm.matches) {
            content.style.opacity = '0';
            content.style.translate = '0 4px';
            requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                content.style.opacity = '';
                content.style.translate = '';
            }));
        }
        // restart the bar tween when cycling; hold it when not
        const bar = el.querySelector('.accordion_progress_bar');
        if (bar) {
            bar.style.transition = 'none';
            bar.style.transform = 'scaleX(0)';
            void bar.offsetWidth;
            bar.style.transition = '';
            bar.style.transform = '';
        }
        if (!interval) el.classList.add('is-held');
    };

    const stopAutoCycle = () => {
        if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
        interval = null;
        accordionElements[currentIndex]?.classList.add('is-held');
        updateButton();
    };

    const canRun = () => !completed && !userPaused && !hovered && !focused && !rm.matches;

    const startAutoCycle = () => {
        if (interval || !canRun()) { updateButton(); return; }
        accordionElements[currentIndex]?.classList.remove('is-held');
        interval = setInterval(() => {
            steps += 1;
            if (steps >= accordionElements.length) {   // one full loop, then stop
                completed = true;
                stopAutoCycle();
                return;
            }
            currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % accordionElements.length;
            activateElement(currentIndex);
        }, STEP_MS);
        updateButton();
    };

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (interval) {
            userPaused = true;
            stopAutoCycle();
        } else {
            userPaused = false;
            if (completed) { completed = false; steps = 0; }
            startAutoCycle();
            if (!interval) updateButton();
        }
    });

    const handleUserClick = (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('.accordion_pause')) return;
        const clickedElement = event.target.closest('.accordion_element_wrap');
        if (!clickedElement) return;
        const clickedIndex = Array.from(accordionElements).indexOf(clickedElement);
        completed = true;                 // the reader took over; motion stops
        stopAutoCycle();
        if (clickedIndex !== currentIndex) {
            currentIndex = clickedIndex;
            activateElement(currentIndex);
        }
    };

    accordionWrap.addEventListener('click', handleUserClick);
    accordionWrap.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => { hovered = true; stopAutoCycle(); });
    accordionWrap.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { hovered = false; startAutoCycle(); });
    accordionWrap.addEventListener('focusin', () => { focused = true; stopAutoCycle(); });
    accordionWrap.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
        if (accordionWrap.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
        focused = false; startAutoCycle();
    });
    if (rm.addEventListener) rm.addEventListener('change', () => { rm.matches ? stopAutoCycle() : startAutoCycle(); });

    const begin = () => {
        if (hasStarted) return;
        hasStarted = true;
        activateElement(currentIndex);   // first row open; paused under reduced motion
        startAutoCycle();
    };

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            if (entries[0].isIntersecting) { begin(); io.disconnect(); }
        }, { threshold: 0.6 });
        io.observe(accordionWrap);
    } else {
        begin();
    }
});

.hero__video-pad{ padding:0 }
.hero__video-still{ border-radius:var(--radius-panel,18px) }
.hero__video-still::after{ display:none }
}
.hero__play{
position:absolute; top:50%; translate:0 -50%; left:9px; z-index:2;
display:flex; align-items:center;
gap:calc(var(--play-size) * .35);
padding:calc(var(--play-size) * .40) calc(var(--play-size) * .60)
calc(var(--play-size) * .40) calc(var(--play-size) * .50);
margin:0; border:0; background:#201F1E; border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer;
transition:translate .2s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1),
background-color .2s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1),
scale .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94),
opacity .2s ease;
-webkit-user-select:none; user-select:none; touch-action:manipulation;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.hero__play::before{
content:""; display:block; flex:0 0 auto;
width:calc(var(--play-size) * .50); height:calc(var(--play-size) * .60);
background:#fff; clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 50%, 0 100%);
}
.hero__play svg{ display:none }
.hero__play span{
display:block; flex:0 0 auto; text-align:left; color:#fff;
font-family:var(--font-text,"InterVariable","Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif);
font-weight:500; font-size:var(--play-size); line-height:1;
letter-spacing:-.022em; translate:0 -1px; text-shadow:none;
}
@media (hover:hover){
.hero__video-still:hover .hero__play{ translate:6px -50% }
.hero__play:hover{ translate:6px -50%; background:#3A3937 }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
.hero__video-still:hover .hero__play, .hero__play:hover{ translate:0 -50% }
.hero__play{ transition:none }
}
.hero__play:active{ scale:.96 }
.hero__play:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:2px }
html.ab-lb-open{ overflow:hidden !important }
.ab-lb{
position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2147483000; overscroll-behavior:contain;
display:grid; place-items:center; padding:24px; box-sizing:border-box;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
opacity:0; transition:opacity .25s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px); backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
.ab-lb[hidden]{ display:none }
.ab-lb.is-in{ opacity:1 }
.ab-lb__close{
position:fixed; top:16px; right:16px; width:32px; height:32px; z-index:2;
display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; padding:0; margin:0; border-radius:8px;
background:transparent; color:#191919; cursor:pointer;
transition:color .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), scale .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94);
}
@media (hover:hover){ .ab-lb__close:hover{ color:#0A0A0A; background:rgba(10,10,10,.06) } }
.ab-lb__close:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #0A0A0A; outline-offset:2px; color:#0A0A0A }
.ab-lb__close:active{ scale:.96 }
.ab-lb__close svg{ width:16px; height:16px; display:block }
.ab-lb__close::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:-4px }
.ab-lb__frame{
position:relative; width:min(1216px, calc(85vh * 16 / 9), 100%); aspect-ratio:16 / 9;
border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; background:transparent; outline:0;
box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
transform:scale(.985); opacity:0;
transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), opacity .25s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);
}
.ab-lb.is-in .ab-lb__frame{ transform:none; opacity:1 }
.ab-lb:not(.is-in){ transition-duration:.18s }
.ab-lb:not(.is-in) .ab-lb__frame{ transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), opacity .18s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) }
.ab-lb__frame:fullscreen{ width:100%; height:100%; aspect-ratio:auto; border-radius:0; box-shadow:none }
.ab-lb__media{ position:absolute; inset:-1px; display:block; overflow:hidden }
.ab-lb__media video{ position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block; object-fit:cover; background:#000 }
.ab-lb__media wistia-player{ position:absolute !important; inset:0 !important; width:100% !important; height:100% !important; margin:0 !important; display:block; background:#000 }
.ab-lb__hit{ position:absolute; inset:0; cursor:pointer; z-index:1 }
.av-frame.is-idle:not(.is-paused),
.av-frame.is-idle:not(.is-paused) .ab-lb__hit{ cursor:none }
.ab-lb__controls{
position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; z-index:3;
padding:32px 12px 12px; box-sizing:border-box;
background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,.8), rgba(0,0,0,0));
color:#fff; opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.av-frame.is-hot .ab-lb__controls,
.av-frame.is-paused .ab-lb__controls,
.av-frame.is-scrubbing .ab-lb__controls,
.av-frame:focus-within .ab-lb__controls{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto }
.av-frame.is-ended .ab-lb__controls{ opacity:0 !important; pointer-events:none !important }
.av-frame.is-ended .ab-lb__hit{ display:none }
.av-frame.is-ended, .av-frame.is-ended .ab-lb__media{ cursor:auto }
.ab-lb__track{
position:relative; height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:10px; touch-action:none;
}
.ab-lb__track::before{ content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:-22px; bottom:-4px }
.ab-lb__buffer, .ab-lb__fill{ position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:0; width:0; border-radius:3px; pointer-events:none }
.ab-lb__buffer{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.3) }
.ab-lb__fill{ background:#fff }
.ab-lb__knob{
position:absolute; top:50%; left:0; width:12px; height:12px; margin:-6px 0 0 -6px; border-radius:50%;
background:#fff; transform:scale(0); transition:transform .15s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.ab-lb__track:hover .ab-lb__knob, .av-frame.is-scrubbing .ab-lb__knob{ transform:scale(1) }
.ab-lb__track:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:4px }
.ab-lb__row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px }
.ab-lb__btn{
position:relative; width:32px; height:32px; display:grid; place-items:center;
border:0; padding:0; margin:0; border-radius:8px;
background:transparent; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; opacity:.92;
transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), opacity .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), scale .15s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94);
}
@media (hover:hover){ .ab-lb__btn:hover{ opacity:1; background:rgba(255,255,255,.12) } }
.ab-lb__btn:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:-2px }
.ab-lb__btn:active{ scale:.96 }
.ab-lb__btn::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:-4px }
.ab-lb__btn svg{ width:16px; height:16px; display:block; grid-area:1 / 1;
transition:opacity .2s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), scale .2s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), filter .2s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1) }
.ab-lb__toggle svg{ width:18px; height:18px }
.ab-lb__i-play, .ab-lb__i-muted,
.av-frame.is-paused .ab-lb__i-pause, .av-frame.is-muted .ab-lb__i-vol{ opacity:0; scale:.25; filter:blur(4px) }
.av-frame.is-paused .ab-lb__i-play, .av-frame.is-muted .ab-lb__i-muted{ opacity:1; scale:1; filter:none }
.ab-lb__time{
display:inline-flex; gap:5px; margin-left:6px;
font:500 12px/1 var(--font-mono,"iA Writer Mono V", ui-monospace, monospace);
font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#fff; letter-spacing:0;
}
.ab-lb__sep{ opacity:.5 }
.ab-lb__spacer{ flex:1 }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
.ab-lb, .ab-lb__frame, .ab-lb__controls, .ab-lb__btn svg{ transition:none !important }
}
@media (hover:none){
.av-frame.is-hot .ab-lb__controls{ opacity:1 }
}
.headline_tabs_content:has(.hero__video-plate){
padding:0; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:0; overflow:visible;

<script>
  (function() {
    // 2026-09-22 B-motion (audit G M4): skip the dot field on coarse pointers (no hover to drive it),
    // cap the canvas to the hero head (~600px, the product frame covers the rest), and redraw at most
    // once per animation frame. Fade keeps its 33ms tick but redraws inside rAF too.
    if (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return;

    let p5Loaded = false;
    let p5Instance = null;
    const MAX_CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
    
    function loadP5() {
      if (p5Loaded) return;
      p5Loaded = true;
      
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      // Use minified version - 50% smaller
      s.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@1.6.0/lib/p5.min.js";

      s.onload = function() {
        p5Instance = new p5(function(p) {
          const dotSize = 2;
          const spacing = dotSize * 8;
          const areaOfEffect = dotSize * 18;
          let dots = [];
          let fadeInterval = null;
          let rafPending = false;

          function canvasHeight(c) {
            return Math.min(c.offsetHeight, MAX_CANVAS_HEIGHT);
          }

          function scheduleRedraw() {
            if (rafPending) return;
            rafPending = true;
            requestAnimationFrame(function() {
              rafPending = false;
              p.redraw();
            });
          }

          p.setup = function() {
            const c = document.getElementById("canvas-container");
            p.createCanvas(c.offsetWidth, canvasHeight(c)).parent(c);
            initializeDots();
            p.noStroke();
            p.frameRate(30); // 30fps is enough for this effect
            p.noLoop(); // Don't run continuously
            p.redraw(); // Draw once
          };

          p.draw = function() {
            p.clear();
            for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
              const dot = dots[i];
              p.fill(92, 92, 92, dot.t);
              p.ellipse(dot.x, dot.y, dot.s);
            }
          };

          p.windowResized = function() {
            const c = document.getElementById("canvas-container");
            p.resizeCanvas(c.offsetWidth, canvasHeight(c));
            initializeDots();
            scheduleRedraw();
          };

          p.mouseMoved = function() {
            // 2026-09-11: the global nav is a transparent fixed code component that sits over the
            // top of this canvas. Don't light dots while the pointer is over it (elementFromPoint
            // returns the <code-island> shadow host there); already-lit dots keep fading out.
            const over = document.elementFromPoint(p.winMouseX, p.winMouseY);
            if (over && over.closest && over.closest('code-island')) return;

            const mouseX = p.mouseX;
            const mouseY = p.mouseY;
            if (mouseY < 0 || mouseY > p.height) return; // pointer below the capped canvas
            
            // Update dots near mouse
            dots.forEach(dot => {
              const distance = p.dist(mouseX, mouseY, dot.x, dot.y);
              if (distance < areaOfEffect) {
                dot.t = 255;
              }
            });
            
            scheduleRedraw();
            
            // Start fade animation if not running
            if (!fadeInterval) {
              fadeInterval = setInterval(function() {
                let anyFading = false;
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                  if (dot.t > 40) {
                    dot.t = Math.max(40, dot.t - 15);
                    anyFading = true;
                  }
                });
                if (anyFading) {
                  scheduleRedraw();
                } else {
                  clearInterval(fadeInterval);
                  fadeInterval = null;
                }
              }, 33); // ~30fps for fade
            }
          };

          function initializeDots() {
            dots = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < p.width; i += spacing) {
              for (let j = 0; j < p.height; j += spacing) {
                dots.push({ x: i + spacing / 2, y: j + spacing / 2, s: dotSize, t: 40 });
              }
            }
          }
        });
      };

      document.body.appendChild(s);
    }
    
    // Lazy load: only load p5.js when canvas is visible
    const canvas = document.getElementById("canvas-container");
    if (canvas) {
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {

            observer.disconnect();
          }

        observer.observe(canvas);
      } else {
        // Fallback for older browsers
        window.addEventListener("load", loadP5);
      }
    }
  })();
</script>
